alt_satir: A crafted Duo flow runs commands on the self-hosted gateway.
gorsel_html:
What is it?

GitLab patched a sandbox escape in the self-hosted AI Gateway on Oct 2. A user with Duo Agent Platform access submits a crafted flow config, escapes the prompt template engine and gets arbitrary command execution.

  • CVE IDCVE-2026-90970
  • ImpactCommand exec on gateway
  • Affected18.1.6 to 19.2.4, 19.3, 19.4.0
  • CVSS9.9 critical · CWE-1336

How it works

  1. User has Duo Agent Platform access.
  2. They submit a crafted flow config.
  3. Template expressions escape the sandbox.
  4. Commands run on the AI Gateway host.

Flow config (representative)

GitLab published no payload. CWE-1336 shape.

# custom flow, Duo Agent Platform
steps:
  - prompt: "{{ TEMPLATE_EXPR }}"
    # engine evaluates it -> shell

Check it today

# which AI Gateway image is running?
$ kubectl -n gitlab get deploy -o yaml \
    | grep -i 'image:.*gateway'
# fixed: 19.2.4 / 19.3.2 / 19.4.1
No fix below 19.2.4. The 19.1 line must move up.

How to defend

  • Upgrade to 19.2.4, 19.3.2 or 19.4.1.
  • Limit who has Duo Agent Platform access.
  • Allow gateway egress to known hosts only.
  • Rotate the gateway JWT and provider keys.
The gateway renders your templates, and your commands.
